Definition
[Linear trace Harnack quadratic] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0052, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0053 1. ch17:17.89–17.93\group Variation Formulas

For a symmetric two-tensor $v$ and vector field $X$, define \[ L(v,X)=\operatorname {div}(\operatorname {div}v)+\langle v,\Ric angle -2\langle \operatorname {div}v,X angle +v(X,X). \] For $X= abla f$ this is \[ L(v, abla f)=(\operatorname {div}- abla f)^2v +\langle \Ric + abla ^2f,v angle . \]
